cz: 新建地区
en: New region

cz: 点击开始一个地区，然后拖动绘制。在已有村庄上点击会纳入它的全部领地。
en: Click to start a region and continue painting. Clicking a village includes its existing land.

cz: 选中地区
en: Select region

cz: 点击已有地区查看名称、所属村庄和面积，并继续绘制。
en: Click a region to see its name and village and continue painting.

cz: 绘制地区
en: Paint region

cz: 拖动扩展当前地区；每个地区最多一个村庄，村庄只能在本地区内扩张。未划定的地方保留原版规则。
en: Drag to expand the selected region. Each region holds one village confined to its borders. Unmarked land follows normal rules.

cz: 擦除地区
en: Erase region

cz: 拖动擦除当前地区的空闲部分。村庄已经占用的格子不能擦除。
en: Drag to erase unused parts of the selected region. Occupied village land is preserved.

cz: 删除地区
en: Delete region

cz: 点击删除整个地区的定制范围并解除边界限制。村庄、建筑和地形保留。
en: Click to delete an entire custom region and release its borders. Villages and terrain remain.

cz: 编辑地区名称
en: Rename region

cz: 点击地图上的地区，输入新名称并保存。名称会显示在地区图层上，并随世界存档保留。
en: Click a region to edit its name. Names appear on the region layer and are saved with the world.

cz: 地区图层
en: Regions layer

cz: 显示玩家绘制的地区边界和名称；亮色为当前编辑地区。
en: Show custom region borders and names. The selected region is highlighted.

en: This overlaps another region. Select or erase that region first.
